# SOP-05: Keeping product codes clean

## Purpose

This procedure is how item 5 of the new process is done. [map/future.md item 5]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| order coordinator | keeps codes in the LC-nnnn form |
| operations manager | approves any change to a code |

## When

Once a week; the Monday clean-up has ended. [map/future.md item 5]

## Steps

1. With codes settled on arrival, there is no Monday clean-up. [map/future.md item 5]
2. Once a week, check that codes stay in the LC-nnnn form (software step: see the Order coordinator guide, "Check product codes stay in the LC-nnnn form"). [SC-05]

## Exceptions and who handles them

A code in another form goes to the operations manager before anything changes. [SC-05]

## Escalation

The operations manager. [map/roles.md operations manager]

## Records kept

Product codes live in the order sheet and the item list. The client has not said how long these are kept; ask before setting a period.

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2027-02-03]
